cards.ex: I've got a huge exam next week, so I really need to hit the books this weekend.
cards.exUz: Kelasi hafta katta imtihonim bor, shuning uchun dam olish kunlari qattiq o'qishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Imtihonga yoki topshiriqqa tayyorlanish uchun ko'p vaqt o'qishga sarflash.

cards.ex: We had to learn the poem by heart for our English class.
cards.exUz: Ingliz tili darsimiz uchun she'rni yod olishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani eslab qolish uchun qayta-qayta o'qib yodlamoq.

cards.ex: She passed the test with flying colors; she got an A+!
cards.exUz: U testdan a'lo baholar bilan o'tdi; u A+ oldi!
cards.uzDef: Imtihondan juda yaxshi natija bilan o'tish, yuqori baho olmoq.

cards.ex: I wouldn't advise you to cut class; it'll hurt your grades.
cards.exUz: Sizga dars qoldirishni maslahat bermayman; bu baholaringizga zarar yetkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Darsga bormaslik, sababsiz darsni tashlab ketish.

cards.ex: If you miss too many classes, you'll start to fall behind.
cards.exUz: Agar juda ko'p dars qoldirsangiz, ortda qola boshlaysiz.
cards.uzDef: O'qishda yoki vazifalarni bajarishda belgilangan muddatdan orqada qolish.

cards.ex: I need to catch up on my reading this weekend.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunlari o'qishimda yetib olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'qishda yoki vazifalarni bajarishda ortda qolgan narsani to'ldirish.

cards.ex: Let's brainstorm some ideas for our group project.
cards.exUz: Keling, guruh loyihamiz uchun ba'zi fikrlar bilan o'rtoqlashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Guruh bo'lib yangi g'oyalarni tezda taklif qilish va muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: I had to pull an all-nighter to finish that essay.
cards.exUz: Men shu inshoni tugatish uchun tun bo'yi o'qishimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Vazifani bajarish uchun butun tun davomida uxlashsiz ishlash yoki o'qish.

cards.ex: She's such a bookworm; she always has her nose in a book.
cards.exUz: U juda kitobxon; u doim kitob o'qish bilan mashg'ul.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p kitob o'qiydigan va o'qishni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: I always cram for exams at the last minute, but it's not a good strategy.
cards.exUz: Men har doim imtihonlarga oxirgi daqiqada tayyorlanaman, lekin bu yaxshi strategiya emas.
cards.uzDef: Imtihonga juda qisqa vaqt ichida ko'p ma'lumot o'rganishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's always answering questions; she's definitely the teacher's pet.
cards.exUz: U doim savollarga javob beradi; u, albatta, o'qituvchining sevimli o'quvchisi.
cards.uzDef: O'qituvchiga yoqadigan va ularning e'tiborini qozongan o'quvchi.

cards.ex: My grandfather's teaching methods are a bit old school, but effective.
cards.exUz: Mening bobomning o'qitish uslublari biroz eski uslubda, ammo samarali.
cards.uzDef: Eski uslubdagi yoki an'anaviy uslubdagi ta'lim.

cards.ex: I need to brush up on my Spanish before I go to Spain.
cards.exUz: Ispaniyaga borishdan oldin ispan tilimni takrorlashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Unutilgan ko'nikmalarni yoki bilimni yangilash, esga solish.

cards.ex: She's majoring in biology at university.
cards.exUz: U universitetda biologiya bo'yicha mutaxassislikka o'qiyapti.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda o'rganiladigan asosiy fan yoki yo'nalish.

cards.ex: He dropped out of college after the first year.
cards.exUz: U birinchi yildan keyin kollejni tashladi.
cards.uzDef: O'qishni tugatmasdan maktabni, kollejni yoki universitetni tashlab ketmoq.

cards.ex: She wants to get a degree in engineering.
cards.exUz: U muhandislik bo'yicha diplom olmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Universitet yoki kollejda o'qishni tugatgandan keyin diplom olmoq.

cards.ex: He's a brilliant student; he always gets straight A's.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib talaba; u har doim faqat a'lo baholar oladi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha fanlardan faqat a'lo baholar olish.

cards.ex: It takes a while to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishlashni o'rganish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror yangi ish yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: If you want to get into a good university, you need to hit the books hard.
cards.exUz: Agar yaxshi universitetga kirmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qattiq o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'qishga ko'p kuch sarflash, qattiq mehnat qilish.

cards.ex: He picked up French really quickly while living in Paris.
cards.exUz: U Parijda yashab, fransuz tilini juda tez o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani oson va tezda o'rganish.

cards.ex: I'm trying to figure out how to solve this math problem.
cards.exUz: Men bu matematika masalasini qanday yechishni aniqlashga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammoni yoki qiyinchilikni hal qilish uchun yechim topish.

cards.ex: It's important to stay on top of your assignments so you don't fall behind.
cards.exUz: Vazifalarni bajarishda ortda qolmaslik uchun ularni nazorat qilib turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ishlarni bajarishda, vazifalarni bajarishda muammolarni oldindan bartaraf etib turish.

cards.ex: He learned everything he knows from the school of hard knocks.
cards.exUz: U bilgan hamma narsani hayot maktabidan o'rgangan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin tajribalar orqali olingan ta'lim va bilim.

cards.ex: He's book smart, but he lacks common sense.
cards.exUz: U kitobdan o'rgangan, lekin oddiy aql yetishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kitoblardan ko'p bilimga ega bo'lgan, lekin amaliy tajribasi kam bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She's street smart and knows how to handle difficult situations.
cards.exUz: U hayotni biladi va qiyin vaziyatlarda o'zini qanday tutishni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik hayotda o'zini tuta oladigan va qiyinchiliklardan chiqa oladigan odam.

cards.ex: Learning a new programming language has a steep learning curve.
cards.exUz: Yangi dasturlash tilini o'rganish qiyin o'rganish jarayoniga ega.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganishda juda ko'p mehnat talab etiladigan jarayon.

cards.ex: Don't pass the buck; take responsibility for your actions.
cards.exUz: Javobgarlikni o'tkazmang; o'z harakatlaringiz uchun javobgarlikni oling.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammoga javobgarlikni boshqa odamga yuklamoq.

cards.ex: The instructions are as easy as ABC; anyone can follow them.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatmalar juda oson; har kim ularga amal qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson bajariladigan yoki tushuniladigan narsa.

cards.ex: If you're struggling, go back to basics and review the fundamentals.
cards.exUz: Agar qiynalayotgan bo'lsangiz, asoslarga qayting va fundamentlarni ko'rib chiqing.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun eng oddiy va asosiy usullarga qaytish.

cards.ex: The teacher always does everything by the book.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi har doim hamma narsani qoidaga muvofiq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga va ko'rsatmalarga qat'iy rioya qilgan holda.
